summary.goal: Capture user interactions (questions answered, preferences expressed) and build a preference model that agents query before asking questions. Reduces question fatigue and enables consistent decision-making.

acceptance_criteria.description: UserTrajectoryEvent entity captures each question answered with context
DerivedPreference extracted from repeated decisions (e.g., 'prefers SQLite')
Preference confidence increases with evidence count
Agents can query getUserPreference(category) before asking
findSimilarQuestions(text, threshold) finds past answers for deduplication
User trajectories persist across runs (project scope)
Override capability: user can change an established preference

observations: User trajectory is separate from agent trajectories
Preference learning is statistical - patterns emerge from repeated decisions
Similarity matching needed for question deduplication
Three scopes: global (all projects), project, run
patterns: Fuzzy text matching for similar questions (0.85 threshold)
Confidence scoring based on evidence count

data_model.UserTrajectoryEvent: { event_id, user_id, scope, question_text, selected_option, reasoning, run_id, task_id, timestamp }
data_model.DerivedPreference: { preference_id, user_id, scope, category, value, confidence, evidence_count, last_expressed }

acceptance_criteria.description: After each decision, analyze for patterns (same category, similar answers)
Create/update DerivedPreference when pattern detected (3+ similar decisions)
Confidence formula: min(0.95, 0.5 + 0.15 * evidence_count)
Categories extracted from question context (e.g., 'database', 'styling', 'testing')

steps.title: Implement getUserPreference query
steps.description: Query user preferences for agent use

acceptance_criteria.description: getUserPreference(userId, scope, category) returns preference if exists with sufficient confidence
Scope priority: run > project > global (more specific wins)
Returns { value, confidence } or null if no preference
Confidence threshold 0.7 for returning preference

architecture.agent_integration: Agents can call before asking redundant questions

steps.title: Implement findSimilarQuestions
steps.description: Find past answers to similar questions

acceptance_criteria.description: findSimilarQuestions(userId, scope, text, threshold=0.85) finds matching past answers
Text similarity using trigram or Levenshtein distance
Returns [{ question_text, selected_option, reasoning, similarity_score }]
Ordered by similarity_score descending

acceptance_criteria.description: PUT /user/preferences/:category allows preference update
Override resets evidence_count to 1, sets new value
Records override as trajectory event for audit
